visualCharacteristics: Home first fold: product quote tabs (Car, Bike, Health, Travel, More) with a panel per tab holding a title, optional input/segmented choice, a Buy now CTA and flow cards, plus campaign art and a scroll cue.
contentPattern: One row per tab: cell 1 = tab icon image + tab label; cell 2 = panel (h2 title, optional icon note, ul choice, field label, <em> placeholder, <strong><a> Buy now CTA, then flow-card paragraphs of image + text). The More panel uses h3 group headings each followed by a ul of image + label items.
usage: Use for the homepage quote-entry hero with tabbed product journeys.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any first fold that offers tabbed product quote entry; not for a simple banner hero.
